definition: to play the main part in a show
description: An old theatre stage with a gold arch and red velvet curtains. A young woman in a long gold sequinned gown stands in the centre in a bright spotlight, arms raised high, laughing. Then she lowers her arms and presses her hands to her chest, smiling at the audience. Behind her two dancers in black move in the blue shadows, one kneeling at the end, in front of a painted night city backdrop. Footlights line the front of the stage and the heads of the audience show in the foreground.

en.question: What is the woman in gold doing?

de.answer: Sie spielt die Hauptrolle in einer Show.
